_comment: Hades-style evolving dialogue. Lines are raw English (pass through Loc). speaker = deity id, 'narrator' (Ferryman), or 'shade' (hub NPC). trigger = hub|boon|death|victory. Modal beats pause + tap to advance; toasts auto-advance.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: You are a soul, wanderer — dead, and refusing to stay that way. You do not recall your name. You recall only that you fled your judgment, and that something in you simply will not lie down.
Six underworlds stand between you and the light above. The lord of each guards his realm — and, though you do not yet know it, something far older besides.
Cast them down, one by one, and reclaim the pieces of yourself they hold. Then, perhaps, the cycle that binds you here will finally break.
Death is no ending in this place. It is only the road. So walk it — and when it kills you, rise, and walk it again.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Another descent awaits. The dead do not rest, wanderer — and so neither shall you.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: The gates stand open, as they always stand. Six thrones of death still wait beyond them.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: A realm has fallen to you, and word of it travels fast among the dead. The other lords take notice now — and they will not greet you so kindly as the first.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Realm upon realm lies broken behind you, and the light above feels nearer than it has any right to. Do not slow now — the dead remember every name that nearly escaped them.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: All six wardens are vanquished, and the cycle... I feel it breaking, here, around you — and I feel what was sealed BEHIND it, waking.
The light above is not the escape I promised. A seventh door has opened below, where no door should be. If you would truly end this, wanderer, you must go down, not up.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Back so soon? The river always returns the drowned.
Rest a moment, then. The dead are patient teachers — and you have lessons left to learn.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Death again. You wear it like a familiar cloak now, hardly even shivering.
Up you get. The road is exactly where you left it.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: I have ferried you more times than my ledger can hold — and still you rise.
Why is that, I wonder? What is it in you that simply will not stay dead?

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: You and your dying — we have made a strange ritual of it, you and I.
But I begin to think the river fears you more than you ever feared it. Go on. Again.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: A realm bows to you. Feel that? The light above draws one step nearer.
Savor it, wanderer — the next lord will have heard you coming.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Another lord cast down. The cycle thins around you, like mist burning off at dawn.
You are becoming something the dead did not plan for.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Again you stand where a god of death once ruled. The underworlds are running short of thrones.
Soon there will be only the road left — and the light waiting at the end of it.

entries.speaker: shade
lines: Another newcomer? Heh. We all think we'll be the one to escape. Stick around — you'll learn the river's name soon enough.

entries.speaker: shade
lines: Still here? So am I. Misery loves company, friend — and down here, company is about all there is.

entries.speaker: shade
lines: You've beaten realms I never even reached. Gods. Maybe it really is possible... If you make it out, think of us down here, would you?

entries.speaker: shade
lines: You did it. You actually... you're going to go. Go on, then — and don't look back at us. Don't you dare look back.

entries.speaker: greece_zeus
lines: So — a mortal soul dares borrow my thunder.
Wield it well, little spark, and do not shame the sky that lent it.

entries.speaker: greece_zeus
lines: Again Olympus answers you. Do not grow proud — lightning forgets no arrogance.

entries.speaker: greece_athena
lines: Wisdom shields those who think before they strike.
Bear my aegis, and let no careless blow ever find you.

entries.speaker: greece_athena
lines: You learn. Good — few souls ever do, and fewer still live to use it.

entries.speaker: greece_hermes
lines: Quick feet, quicker wit — try to keep up, little soul!
Speed is its own kind of mercy down here. Take mine.

entries.speaker: greece_hermes
lines: Still running? Then run faster — the dead are slow, but they are many.

entries.speaker: greece_ares
lines: Blood and fury! Spill them in my name.
Let every shade you meet learn the weight of my favor.

entries.speaker: greece_ares
lines: Yes — again! Let them dread the very sound of your coming.

entries.speaker: greece_artemis
lines: Aim true. The hunt rewards the patient and punishes the rash.
Loose your shot only when it cannot miss.

entries.speaker: greece_artemis
lines: A clean kill. The wild is proud of you, hunter.

entries.speaker: bali_acintya
lines: All things in balance, traveler — light and dark, life and ash.
I grant you wholeness. Spend it wisely.

entries.speaker: bali_acintya
lines: You walk the middle path well. Few keep their footing upon it.

entries.speaker: bali_barong
lines: Stand firm. My mane will guard you from the dark that bites.
Where Rangda's children gather, let them break against you.

entries.speaker: bali_barong
lines: Rangda's shadow fears you now. Good. Let it fear.

entries.speaker: bali_dewi_danu
lines: Drink deep of the lake's life, child.
Its waters have fed these valleys since before the gods were named.

entries.speaker: bali_dewi_danu
lines: The waters remember your face now. You may always return to them.

entries.speaker: bali_dewi_sri
lines: From the rice, abundance; from abundance, strength.
Be nourished, and carry the harvest with you into the dark.

entries.speaker: bali_dewi_sri
lines: You flourish even here. Carry the harvest onward.

entries.speaker: bali_batara_kala
lines: All falls to ruin in time — that is no cruelty, only truth.
Borrow my hunger, and hasten what must come.

entries.speaker: bali_batara_kala
lines: Time devours all things. All but you, it seems — not yet.

entries.speaker: egypt_ra
lines: The sun's own fire is yours to carry into the night-road.
Burn away the dark, mortal, as I burn it back each dawn.

entries.speaker: egypt_ra
lines: You blaze brightly. Take care you are not consumed by your own light.

entries.speaker: egypt_osiris
lines: Death is not the end — I, of all gods, should know it.
Endure as I endured, traveler, and you will live again.

entries.speaker: egypt_osiris
lines: Risen again. The Duat cannot keep what it cannot hold.

entries.speaker: egypt_anubis
lines: I weigh every heart against the feather of truth.
Yours is heavy — not with sin, but with resolve. Carry it onward.

entries.speaker: egypt_anubis
lines: Send them to me. I will judge whatever remains when you are done.

entries.speaker: egypt_horus
lines: Strike like the falcon — swift, certain, and from above.
My eye misses nothing. See that yours misses nothing either.

entries.speaker: egypt_horus
lines: Your aim is keen now. Strike, and do not hesitate.

entries.speaker: egypt_set
lines: Chaos is power — if you have the nerve to wield it.
Take mine, and let the orderly dead tremble.

entries.speaker: egypt_set
lines: Reckless? Yes. Effective? Also yes. I approve.

entries.speaker: egypt_sekhmet
lines: Roar, little lion. The hunt is a prayer, and blood the offering.
Bathe in it, and grow strong.

entries.speaker: egypt_sekhmet
lines: The lioness is pleased. Hunt on — do not stop to rest.

entries.speaker: norse_odin
lines: All knowledge has its price. I gave an eye for mine.
Pay yours, and grow wise enough to walk back out of Hel.

entries.speaker: norse_odin
lines: The runes whisper your name now, even in the halls of the slain.

entries.speaker: norse_thor
lines: Swing as I swing — let nothing in the nine worlds stand before you!
Ha! This will make a tale worth the telling.

entries.speaker: norse_thor
lines: HA! Again! Crush them, friend — and crush them well!

entries.speaker: norse_freyja
lines: Beauty and war are one blade with two edges.
Take my seidr, and learn to wield them both.

entries.speaker: norse_freyja
lines: You please me. Half the fallen will be yours to claim.

entries.speaker: norse_tyr
lines: Hold the line, even at cost — especially at cost.
That is honor, and honor is the one thing the dead still respect.

entries.speaker: norse_tyr
lines: Steadfast. Few keep their oath as faithfully as you do.

entries.speaker: norse_heimdall
lines: I see every road from where I stand at the world's edge.
Walk yours with open eyes, and nothing will catch you unaware.

entries.speaker: norse_heimdall
lines: Nothing surprises you now. Stay watchful — the dark is patient.

entries.speaker: norse_loki
lines: Oh, this will be fun. Here — a little chaos, just for you.
Try not to lose a hand with it. Or do. I'd laugh either way.

entries.speaker: norse_loki
lines: Back again? You and I, friend — we understand each other.

entries.speaker: japan_amaterasu
lines: Let my light drive back the shadows of Yomi.
Even in the land of rot, the sun may still shine — through you.

entries.speaker: japan_amaterasu
lines: You shine, even here in the dark. It is a beautiful thing to see.

entries.speaker: japan_susanoo
lines: Ride the storm! Let the seas rage and the sky split open with you!
My sister keeps her light. I keep the tempest. Take a share of it.

entries.speaker: japan_susanoo
lines: The tempest knows you now, and answers when you call. Good.

entries.speaker: japan_raijin
lines: Thunder answers only the bold — and you are bold enough.
Take it, and let the drums of the storm follow your every step.

entries.speaker: japan_raijin
lines: BOOM! Louder each time, little one! I can scarcely hear myself!

entries.speaker: japan_fujin
lines: Swift as the wind from my bag of gales — go, before they even blink.
Let no shade in Yomi ever lay a hand upon you.

entries.speaker: japan_fujin
lines: You move like a gale now. They cannot strike what they cannot catch.

entries.speaker: japan_tsukuyomi
lines: Strike from the moonlit shadow, where the light does not reach.
The night is long, and patient, and yours.

entries.speaker: japan_tsukuyomi
lines: The night hides you well, hunter. Use it.

entries.speaker: japan_inari
lines: Fox-fire and fortune favor the clever over the strong.
Take both, and be cunning enough to keep them.

entries.speaker: japan_inari
lines: The fox smiles upon you. Stay clever, and the smile will hold.

entries.speaker: aztec_huitzilopochtli
lines: War feeds the sun, and the sun feeds the world.
Fight, mortal, and let the dawn rise upon your offering.

entries.speaker: aztec_huitzilopochtli
lines: The sun burns hotter for every battle you give it.

entries.speaker: aztec_quetzalcoatl
lines: Ride the feathered wind, wise one, high above the bone-roads.
I gave mankind its arts long ago. Let me give you this.

entries.speaker: aztec_quetzalcoatl
lines: You learn the old wisdom well. Soar with it.

entries.speaker: aztec_tlaloc
lines: Let the storm-rain fall upon your foes, sweet and pitiless.
I drown gardens and I feed them, both with the same water. Choose well.

entries.speaker: aztec_tlaloc
lines: The rains come when you call them now. Spend them sparingly.

entries.speaker: aztec_tezcatlipoca
lines: Look into the smoking mirror... and take what you see there.
Even if what you see is only yourself, sharpened to an edge.

entries.speaker: aztec_tezcatlipoca
lines: Trickster to trickster — well played, little smoke.

entries.speaker: aztec_mictlantecuhtli
lines: All roads end at my throne of bone, soul. Yours among them, in time.
Until that day, I lend you death's own hand. Do not waste it.

entries.speaker: aztec_mictlantecuhtli
lines: You send so many down to me. I remember every face you bring.

entries.speaker: aztec_xochipilli
lines: Feast, dance, bloom! Even the dead may yet live a little!
Take my joy — down here it cuts sharper than any blade.

entries.speaker: aztec_xochipilli
lines: You flourish in the dark. How utterly delightful you are.
